forward_blind_test_4body.claim: If a 4-body partition row appears in any FUTURE CR119 extension with the same structural class as OCTET_COMPOSITE 3-body, its M_native = R * [s1^2 + Delta^2] = 4*R*(a^2+b^2+c^2+d^2) = 48*(a^2+b^2+c^2+d^2).
forward_blind_test_4body.falsifier: ONE single 4-body row whose M_native differs from the conjecture formula by any non-zero integer falsifies v1.0.
forward_blind_test_4body.non_falsifying: Continued absence of 4-body rows in the catalog; rows of other operator_class with different generators; algebra extensions.

four_body_conjecture.claim: M_4(a, b, c, d) = R * [s1^2 + Delta^2]
four_body_conjecture.lagrange_collapse: Using Sum_{pairs} (a_i - a_j)^2 = n*Sum a_i^2 - s1^2, the n=4 formula collapses to:  M_4 = 4*R * (a^2+b^2+c^2+d^2) = 48 * (a^2+b^2+c^2+d^2)
four_body_conjecture.name: M_4_LAGRANGE_EXTENSION_v1
four_body_conjecture.open_question: Whether the prefactor scales as R*n for n >= 3 (giving R*n*Sum a_i^2), or follows another n-dependence, is not yet derivable from CR119 alone -- no 4-body rows are currently in the catalog.

immutability: CR130 rewriting identity, structural explanation, and 4-body conjecture are frozen at seal time.  Future falsification or refinement must be in an appeal CR.

rewriting_identity.name: NEWTON_3BODY_REWRITE
rewriting_identity.verification_method: in-sample evaluation on all 76 3-body OCTET rows: direct CR129 formula and CR130 rewrite must both equal M_observed and equal each other (Newton identity).

argument: Sum over signed pairwise differences vanishes identically for any n: Sum_{i!=j} (a_i - a_j) = 0.
Hence linear antisymmetric is forbidden in fully-symmetric formulas at every n.
At n = 2: catalog stores both orderings (doublet); M_native is symmetric in {a,b} but admits |a-b| (linear, fully-symmetric in the unordered pair).
At n >= 3: catalog stores one entry per multiset; M_native must be fully symmetric; antisymmetric content survives only at QUADRATIC order via Sum (a_i - a_j)^2.
structural_explanation.implication: The structural form CHANGE at the 2->3 boundary (linear-antisymmetric to squared-antisymmetric) is FORCED by representation theory of the symmetric group acting on partition multisets, combined with the requirement that antisymmetric content enter via natural products of the dozenal R=12 algebra.
structural_explanation.principle: For n >= 3 fully-symmetric M_native, linear antisymmetric content CANNOT appear; only quadratic (sum-of-squared-differences) survives.

two_body_structural_distinction.claim: The 2-body formula M_2 = R*ab + D*|a-b| is structurally distinct from the n >= 3 family.
two_body_structural_distinction.consequence: The 2-body case is the only one with linear antisymmetric content; n >= 3 has only quadratic.
evidence: If the rewriting R*[s1^2 + Delta^2] were applied at n=2, it would give 2*R*(a^2+b^2). For (1,2): 2*12*5 = 120. Observed M_2(1,2) = 27. MISMATCH.
2-body permits MIXED degree (degree-2 R*ab and degree-1 D*|a-b|) because the catalog stores both orderings as a doublet with the sign rule encoded in S_debit.
n >= 3 forces uniform degree (quadratic) because only one entry per multiset is stored.
